meta.title: Start with Frankencoin: save in Swiss francs or invest in FCS
meta.description: Pick a goal, see what your money would have done, and do it in three steps. Save ZCHF at the protocol rate or invest in Frankencoin Shares.

hero.title: Put your money in Swiss francs. On-chain.
hero.subtitle: Two ways to take part: save ZCHF and earn the protocol rate, or hold FCS and own a share of the reserve. See the numbers first, then do it in three steps.

save.title: Save
save.body: Deposit ZCHF in the savings module. Interest accrues every block. Withdraw whenever you want, no lock-up.

invest.title: Invest
invest.body: Buy Frankencoin Shares (FCS). You own part of the reserve pool that collects every minter's fees and interest, and you can vote.
bullets: Price can go down as well as up

steps.title: Do it in three steps
steps.subtitle: About ten minutes the first time. No account with Frankencoin: you keep your own keys.

items.title: Get ZCHF
items.body: Bank transfer from any Swiss or SEPA account (Mt Pelerin, 0% fees), or swap from USDC, USDT or ETH.

items.title: Connect a wallet
items.body: Any Ethereum wallet works: MetaMask, Rabby, Ledger, Coinbase Wallet. ZCHF lives on Ethereum and seven other chains.

items.title: Save or buy FCS
items.body: One transaction. Savings show up on the Earn page; FCS lands in your wallet.

items.a: No. Savings can be withdrawn at any time. FCS can be sold on the open market or redeemed through the protocol after the holding period.

items.q: Where does the savings interest come from?
items.a: From people who borrow ZCHF against collateral. They pay interest into the reserve; savers are paid from it first.
Smart-contract risk, collateral falling faster than auctions can sell it, and for FCS, the share price falling when the reserve shrinks. Read the risks before you start.

items.q: Do I need to know DeFi?
items.a: You need a wallet and some ZCHF. Everything else is one page and one button.
